params.name: supply_node_ref
params.description: Supply node ref to return rate cards for

params.name: ea_icp_id
params.description: ICP number to return rate cards for

params.name: start_at
params.description: Return rate cards on or after (>=) a specific time. Leave blank to return all available rate cards

params.name: end_at
params.description: Return rate cards before (<) a specific time. Leave blank to return all available rate cards

params.name: existing_customer_plans
params.description: Return rate cards for existing customer plans

params.name: generation_price_contract
params.description: Generation price contract code. One of 'generation_price_contract', 'product_code', or 'brand' is required

params.name: product_code
params.description: Name of the product. One of 'generation_price_contract', 'product_code', or 'brand' is required

params.name: brand
params.description: Name of the brand. One of 'generation_price_contract', 'product_code', or 'brand' is required

params.name: location_classification
params.description: Whether this is a residential or commercial customer; if no value is provided, it will default to the best compatible option. 'location_classification' and 'usage_type' must be passed together

params.name: usage_type
params.description: Whether the customer opts for a Standard or Low User plan; if no value is provided, it will default to the best compatible option. 'location_classification' and 'usage_type' must be passed together

meta.description: Returns rate cards for a supply node with current location classification and all available usage types
